pythonpath-src-for-tests.fact: Tests in this repository import the `src` package, so run pytest with `PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest` rather than bare `python -m pytest`, which fails with an ImportError.

make-fixtures-before-tests.fact: Test fixtures are not present by default; run `make fixtures` before running the test suite, or tests fail with FileNotFoundError under tests/fixtures.

make-fmt-formatter.fact: The project formatter is run with `make fmt` (backed by scripts/fmt.py), and CI checks formatting of src, so use it for formatting changes.
